personality_one_liner: A bold, friendly, and tactile space that makes building habits feel rewarding, energetic, and satisfying.

spacing.rule: Maintain generous breathing room to reinforce the tactile, friendly vibe. Avoid dense nesting.

do_s: Use glass for the bottom tab bar to create depth when lists scroll underneath.
Use glass for floating action buttons (FAB) over a brandTertiary base.
Use glass for bottom sheet headers.
dont_s: Do not use glass for individual habit cards.
Do not blur forms or standard scrollable content.

screens.name: Today
screens.purpose: Action-oriented dashboard listing active habits for today with quick-log controls.

states.loading: Centered brand-colored activity indicator with playful pulsing animation.
states.empty: 3D illustration with a friendly prompt ('No habits yet! Let\'s start small.') and a large Primary FAB.
states.error: Soft error message with a retry button in brandSecondary.

screens.layout: Header with 'Today' title and large current streak count. Vertical scrollable list of Habit Cards. Each card (surfaceSecondary) is chunky, features a large emoji on the left, habit name, progress ring, and a pill-shaped quick-log stepper (+1 or +15m) on the right. FAB (brandPrimary) floats at bottom right for adding a habit. Pad bottom scroll with extra space for FAB/TabBar.

screens.name: Habits
screens.purpose: Global list and CRUD management for all habits.

states.loading: Skeleton rows reflecting the chunky card structure.
states.empty: 3D illustration showing a blank list. 'Your routine is a blank slate.'
states.error: Error message with soft warning colors and retry CTA.

screens.layout: Grid or vertical list of all habits. Filter chips at the top (All, Fitness, Mindfulness, etc.). Tap a card to open the bottom sheet or detail view for Edit/Archive.

screens.name: Stats (Detail & Global)
screens.purpose: Visualize history, progress, and consistency over time via heatmaps and streak badges.

states.empty: Illustration of a seed sprouting. 'Log data to see your garden grow!'
states.error: Failed to load stats message with a retry button.

screens.layout: Global Stats: Weekly completion rate bar chart, per-habit summary list. Habit Detail: 7-row horizontally scrolling GitHub-style heatmap. Colors scale from surfaceTertiary (missed) -> brandTertiary (partial) -> brandPrimary (completed). Display current & longest streak prominently in oversized tactile badges. Chart showing last 30 days progress below heatmap.

empty_today.alt: 3D illustration of a checklist with checkmarks

empty_stats.alt: Playful 3D green geometric shapes representing growth

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly follow the Tactile / Playful personality (4). Maintain chunky radius (sm:12, md:16, lg:24, pill:999).
Implement the Today screen as a 'Bento-style' layout if possible, or use thick, card-like rows with plenty of internal padding.

The Heatmap (GitHub-style) should be 7 rows tall, scrolling horizontally. Map the 'missed' state to surfaceTertiary (which is a neutral gray, as requested). Map activity tiers to brandTertiary and brandPrimary.
For the quick-log component on the habit card, use a pill-shaped container with a + stepper. When the daily target is reached, trigger a success haptic and fill the progress ring dynamically.
Use Phosphor icons (filled for active, outlined for inactive).

Since Android performance is a key concern for long-term use, ensure the GitHub heatmap uses lightweight components (like small localized Views or React Native SVGs) and avoids heavy re-renders when horizontally scrolling.
Make sure forms/inputs have labels above inputs and submit buttons are pinned to the keyboard.
Emoji should be handled natively but rendered at a large size inside a brandTertiary tinted circular container for visual pop.
